CrusaderZealousGlare.name: Zealous Glare
CrusaderZealousGlare.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 75% more damage.

CrusaderPassiveDivineFortress.name: Divine Fortress
CrusaderPassiveDivineFortress.description: Basic Attacks grant 10 Physical Armor for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40. Gambit: Gain 20% bonus maximum Health. Every death reduces this bonus by 5%.

CrusaderMasteryLawsOfHope.name: Laws of Hope
CrusaderMasteryLawsOfHope.description: Activate to heal 20% of Johanna's max Health over 5 seconds. Quest: Every 10 Regeneration Globes gathered increases this heal amount by 5% of Johanna's max Health.

CrusaderMasteryPunishSubdue.name: Subdue
CrusaderMasteryPunishSubdue.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 80% and the Slow amount does not decay. Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish. Reward: Punish always Slows by 80%.

CrusaderMasteryCondemnEternalRetaliation.name: Eternal Retaliation
CrusaderMasteryCondemnEternalRetaliation.description: Mark enemies hit by Condemn for 10 seconds. Johanna's next Basic Attack against them removes the mark, lowering the cooldown of Condemn by 1 second, refunding 10 Mana, and killing Minions.

CrusaderMasteryIronSkinHoldYourGround.name: Hold Your Ground
CrusaderMasteryIronSkinHoldYourGround.description: Increases Iron Skin's Shield by 40% and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

CrusaderMasteryShieldGlareSinsExposed.name: Sins Exposed
CrusaderMasteryShieldGlareSinsExposed.description: Punish reduces healing received by 35% for 3 seconds. Basic Attacks against them refresh this duration.

CrusaderMasteryCondemnConviction.name: Conviction
CrusaderMasteryCondemnConviction.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

CrusaderIronSkinSteedCharge.name: Steed Charge
CrusaderIronSkinSteedCharge.description: Activate to instantly Mount for 3 seconds, unhindered by damage. Passive: Increase the duration of Iron Skin by 2 second.

CrusaderHeroicAbilityFallingSword.name: Falling Sword
CrusaderHeroicAbilityFallingSword.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

CrusaderHeroicAbilityBlessedShield.name: Blessed Shield
CrusaderHeroicAbilityBlessedShield.description: Deal 114 (+4% per level) damage and Stun the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. Blessed Shield then bounces to 2 nearby enemies, dealing 57 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.75 seconds.

CrusaderMasteryPunishRoar.name: Roar
CrusaderMasteryPunishRoar.description: Increase Punish's damage by 50%. This bonus is increased to 150% whenever Punish hits 2 or more Heroes.

CrusaderHolyFury.name: Holy Fury
CrusaderHolyFury.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

CrusaderBlessedHammer.name: Blessed Hammer
CrusaderBlessedHammer.description: Activate to create 2 hammers that spiral outward from Johanna, dealing 74 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit. Damaging enemies with Basic Abilities reduce the cooldown of this Ability by 2 seconds. Passive: Every 3rd Basic Attack against enemy Heroes releases a hammer.

CrusaderCondemnShrinkingVacuum.name: Shrinking Vacuum
CrusaderCondemnShrinkingVacuum.description: Condemn reduces enemy Heroes damage by 25% and Slows by 25% for 2 seconds.

CrusaderMasteryShieldGlareHolyRenewal.name: Holy Renewal
CrusaderMasteryShieldGlareHolyRenewal.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1.5 seconds and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

CrusaderBlessedMomentum.name: Blessed Momentum
CrusaderBlessedMomentum.description: Basic Attacks grant 10% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds, stacking up to 40%. They also reduce Johanna's Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

CrusaderMasteryFallingSwordHeavensFury.name: Heaven's Fury
CrusaderMasteryFallingSwordHeavensFury.description: Falling Sword rains down holy bolts, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, healing allied Heroes for 68 (+4% per level), and reducing its cooldown by 1 second for each Hero hit.

CrusaderMasteryBlessedShieldRadiatingFai.name: Radiating Faith
CrusaderMasteryBlessedShieldRadiatingFai.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blessed Shield by 2. Its Stun duration is increased to 1.75 seconds and all targets hit are Stunned for the maximum duration.

CrusaderHeroicMasteryIndestructable.name: Indestructible
CrusaderHeroicMasteryIndestructable.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Johanna gains a Shield equal to her maximum Health for 4 seconds. This effect has a 120 second cooldown.

CrusaderBlindedByTheLight.name: Blinded By The Light
CrusaderBlindedByTheLight.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds. Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.
